title: On the Variety of Hyperspace Selections
summary: If $f$ is a continuous selection for the Vietoris hyperspace $\mathcal{F}(X)$ of the nonempty closed subsets of a space $X$, then the point $p=f(X)\in X$ is not as arbitrary as it might seem at first glance. In fact, the set $\mathcal{O}_{cs}(X)$ of all these points reveals certain information about the variety of Vietoris continuous selections for $\mathcal{F}(X)$. Thus, for a connected space $X$, we will show that every point $p\in \mathcal{O}_{cs}(X)$ is not only noncut, but also an endpoint of $X$.
